method: Source + route + UI + test + DB-sim + CI inspection (not a documentation rubber stamp). Every status below is backed by merged code and a green LANE_B run.

restrictions.title: Read-only cockpit affordances
restrictions.originalIssue: The ProcessExecutionTask cockpit could only DISPLAY the bridged action; the owner had to re-key the diagnosis into a separate form to act. No interactive, governed execution surface existed.
evidence: POST /api/owner/process-execution (src/app/api/owner/process-execution/route.ts) exposes 9 governed actions (start/approve/reject/delegate/submit-evidence/complete/request-reassessment/mark-blocked/request-missing-data); server-authoritative — it re-derives + persists the route before applying, so the client never supplies route fields.

applyProcessExecutionAction (src/services/owner-mode/process-execution-bridge.service.ts) enforces every guardrail: isOwnerOnly() owner-only approve/reject/delegate, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED_ROUTES + detectFakeCompletion gate completion, NON_ACTIONABLE_ROUTES block unsafe/monitor, terminal statuses refuse further action.
ProcessExecutionBridgePanel (src/components/owner/ProcessIntelligencePanel.tsx) renders only the transitions allowed by status/approval/route via allowedBridgeActions(); performs no mutation itself.
Every transition writes OWNER_PROCESS_EXECUTION_TASK_TRANSITIONED in the same $transaction.
restrictions.uiProof: process-execution-bridge-panel.test.tsx proves controls appear only for allowed transitions, guardrail language is visible, and the panel calls back without mutating.
restrictions.remainingLimitation: The interactive surface covers ProcessExecutionTask routes only; other cockpit families (opportunity execution) remain read-only by scope, not by this restriction.
restrictions.nextRemediation: None required for R1. Extend the same interactive pattern to opportunity execution in a future, separate pass if desired.

restrictions.title: Workload / capability / standalone SOP-training engines bridged only through the process-correction router
restrictions.originalIssue: The workload, capability-gap, standalone SOP, and standalone training engines could influence execution ONLY indirectly, through process-correction findings. They had no direct route into the governed ProcessExecutionTask substrate.
evidence: process-execution-bridge-expansion.ts bridges five engines DIRECTLY into BridgedExecutionRoute with new source families: WORKLOAD_REDUCTION, CAPABILITY_GAP, SOP_CHECKLIST, TRAINING, EFFECTIVENESS_RECHECK.
Owner Now View feeds all five in-scope analyses to buildProcessExecutionBridge via buildBridgeExpansion (src/services/owner-guidance/owner-now-view.service.ts).
Workload/SOP/training now emit their own governed routes; a specific SOP/training route COLLAPSES the generic correction route for the same fix (no duplicate).
restrictions.dbProof: LANE_B run 28794768833 — 43 files / 363 tests green, printed LANE_B_DB_VERIFIED (PR #155).
restrictions.uiProof: ProcessExecutionBridgePanel shows a source-family label (FAMILY_LABEL) so the owner sees which engine surfaced each action.
restrictions.remainingLimitation: Workload, standalone SOP, and standalone training are fully direct-bridged. The CAPABILITY_GAP family is intentionally gated: low-value / non-blocking capability recommendations stay MONITOR_ONLY to avoid flooding the cockpit with low-value build backlog. That monitoring tail is a deliberate anti-flood safety design, not an advisory-only gap.
restrictions.nextRemediation: Optionally add an owner-initiated 'promote a monitored capability to a build task' control if owners want to pull low-value gaps into execution on demand.

restrictions.title: SOP-adherence re-check
restrictions.originalIssue: After an SOP/checklist or training fix, there was no execution-routed re-check of whether the fix actually held; effectiveness was advisory only and risked a false 'it worked' claim.
evidence: bridgeEffectivenessEvaluation (process-execution-bridge-expansion.ts): a verified IMPROVED result routes to MONITOR_ONLY with 'Verified adherent' and NO completable action — it can never be 'completed' to fake effectiveness.
A WORSENED/UNCHANGED result becomes an evidence-gated actionable re-check (RETRAIN/MODIFY/ESCALATE); ESCALATE stays OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA routes to a data task (NEEDS_DATA), never a claim the fix worked.
tests: process-execution-bridge-expansion.test.ts cases 8-10 (IMPROVED monitor-only, WORSENED actionable, INSUFFICIENT_DATA data task)
workload-capability-sop-training-bridge.db.test.ts case 8 (IMPROVED re-check is monitor-only and NOT completable)
restrictions.uiProof: EFFECTIVENESS_RECHECK routes render through the same panel with the 'Did the fix work?' family label.
restrictions.remainingLimitation: Adherence is expressed via the effectiveness DIRECTION (IMPROVED/WORSENED/UNCHANGED/INSUFFICIENT_DATA) rather than a dedicated persisted adherence-classification enum (VERIFIED_ADHERENT/NOT_ADHERENT/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE/NEEDS_RECHECK). The re-check depends on a prior snapshot baseline; with no baseline it is honestly INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
restrictions.nextRemediation: If explicit adherence labels are required as first-class persisted state, add an AdherenceClassification derived field on the effectiveness route in a future pass.

restrictions.title: Adjudication auth scope
restrictions.originalIssue: Adjudication-queue authorization scope was not part of the execution-bridge burn-down and was not re-verified end-to-end in this loop.
evidence: Out of scope for PASS 22-24 (execution-bridge affordances + engine bridging). No adjudication auth path was changed; the existing centralized policy/capability layer remains in force.
The new POST route enforces CAPABILITIES.OWNER_MANAGE + requireWorkspace server-side; it does not widen adjudication scope.
restrictions.remainingLimitation: Adjudication auth scope remains a non-blocking proof-scope restriction — explicitly retained, not weakened. It gates no execution-bridge behaviour shipped in this loop.
restrictions.nextRemediation: Schedule a dedicated adjudication-authorization re-audit pass (two-tenant cross-scope tests) outside the execution-bridge loop.

restrictions.title: Inline complaint auto-route
restrictions.originalIssue: Complaint/rework signals needed a safe inline route into governed execution, with owner approval for reputation/refund/legal risk and no auto-customer-contact or auto-discount.
evidence: Complaint/rework enters via ProcessIntelligence finding types QUALITY_FAILURE_LOOP and REWORK_LOOP, which the correction router turns into corrections that the bridge materialises: QUALITY_FAILURE_LOOP -> ESCALATE_TO_OWNER (owner approval for reputation risk), REWORK_LOOP -> REVIEW_PROCESS_STEP, RESOLVE_OPERATIONAL_EVENT -> a reassessment task.

workload-capability-sop-training-bridge.db.test.ts case 5 proves a complaint correction persists a CREATE_REASSESSMENT_TASK and an owner-escalation route; case 6 proves the owner-escalation requires owner approval (a non-owner APPROVE fails).
No route contacts a customer, applies a discount, submits a tender, spends, signs, or touches payroll (asserted by the route's design + the no-external-side-effect guard).
restrictions.uiProof: Complaint-derived routes render through the panel with owner-approval / evidence language.
restrictions.remainingLimitation: Complaint/rework routes inline through the correction router's finding types rather than a dedicated complaint-intake channel. Reputation/refund/legal-risk items are held at OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED by design (safe), so they are not auto-executed — a deliberate safety boundary, not an advisory gap.
restrictions.nextRemediation: Add a first-class complaint-intake surface if direct complaint capture (outside process findings) is later required.

restrictions.title: Exhaustive read / audit proofs
restrictions.originalIssue: A full, exhaustive read/audit of every governed read path across the whole corpus was not reproduced in-session; proof rests on the incremental per-pass tests + DB-gated CI.
evidence: Each pass added targeted DB sims wired into LANE_B/LANE_A and proven green in CI (runs 28790402937, 28794768833).
governance:scan:strict, lint:ratchet, tsc, and next build gate every merge; the whole-corpus static aggregate audit job runs in CI.
restrictions.remainingLimitation: A single exhaustive, in-session read/audit of every governed read path across all domains is intentionally out of scope; it is a non-blocking proof-scope restriction covered incrementally by per-pass DB sims + CI gates.
restrictions.nextRemediation: If a single consolidated exhaustive audit artifact is required, generate it in a dedicated audit-only pass; it does not gate any execution behaviour.

classificationRationale: R1 is fully removed (owner acts from the cockpit for supported findings). R2/R3/R5 are reduced to safe, non-critical edge cases (direct bridging with deliberate monitor-only / owner-approval safety boundaries). R4 and R6 are explicitly retained as non-blocking proof-scope restrictions. No critical or high advisory-only execution gap remains. We deliberately do NOT claim the full ACCEPTED tier because R3 is reduced (adherence derived from effectiveness direction rather than a dedicated persisted adherence enum) rather than fully removed — classifying it as ACCEPTED would overclaim.
